permitted_use: Other permitted uses, except as otherwise specified in this title

standards.SUBPART B: Each site shall have a minimum frontage of at least 150 feet along a street with adequate capacity to serve the proposed project, except that a cul-de-sac or turning heel shall have a minimum average lot width of 150 feet
standards.SUBPART C: Required front yards shall be landscaped, except for necessary walks and drives; this area may be included in meeting landscaping requirements of Title 18
standards.SUBPART D: 35; may exceed 35 feet when an additional setback of one foot is provided from all adjacent yardlines for each foot of height in excess of 35.
